selected.title: NAB cuts 2,500 jobs citing technological change
selected.summary: National Australia Bank (NAB) is to axe 2,500 employees in its latest restructuring, equivalent to 6% of the workforce
selected.why: Major bank restructuring cutting 2,500 jobs citing technological change.

reason: NAB job cuts frame tech as the cause, but bank strategy choices—not technological inevitability—drive redundancies. Argues banks use 'tech change' to obscure decisions about profit allocation over employment.
angle: Banks invoke technological change as cover for restructuring choices that reflect capital priorities, not technical necessity.
